name: @ninjapaw/developer-usage-insights
description: Local Azure DevOps and GitHub plan, usage, billing, and activity reports with CSV, PDF, and HTML exports.
author: Ninja Paws community

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start --workspace api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/metadata && npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace app && npm run build --workspace api
scripts.demo:generate: npm run build --workspace packages/metadata && npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run build --workspace api && node scripts/generate-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:build: npm run demo:generate && npm run build --workspace demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/metadata && npm run build --workspace packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace app && npm run typecheck --workspace api
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace app && npm run test:unit --workspace api
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:exe && npm run test:exe
